prerequisites: Estructuras y Construcciones Industriales (Structures and Industrial Constructions)

learning_outcomes.text: Draft and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering that aim at the construction, renovation, conservation, and demolition of industrial structures and plants.
Analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Apply the principles and methods of quality applied in industrial construction.
Know, understand and apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.
Know and apply the technological aspects required to design industrial buildings complying with the requirements set out in the applicable regulations and the required functionality.
Know and apply the legislation, specifications, regulations and mandatory standards in the field of industrial constructions.

syllabus_topics: Industrial architecture. Introduction to the architecture of industrial buildings.
Industrial urban planning, fundamentals of urban planning regulations. Industrial estates.
Regulatory aspects affecting the conception of the building: User safety and fire safety.
Fundamentals of geotechnics. Typologies and characteristics of foundation systems.
Typologies and characteristics of structural systems in industrial buildings.
Flat support elements: Typologies and characteristics of floor slabs.
Typologies and characteristics of enclosure systems in industrial buildings.
Typologies and characteristics of pavements and coatings used in industrial buildings.
Conditions and requirements of fire protection elements in industrial buildings.
Mandatory documents in the drafting of the Execution Project for an Industrial Building.

assessment_methods.method: Completion of practical assignments (exercises, cases or problems)
Demonstrated interest in the subject content

assessment_rules: Evaluation will be based on work developed and demonstrated interest during the course. A minimum attendance of 75% of classroom hours is required for approval. For final evaluation, students must submit and defend reports and works. To renounce the call, simply do not attend the final exam. For the extraordinary call, students will be evaluated through a final written exam, including an oral exam, to achieve 100% of the grade.
